messages:
deploy-bot: CONFIG-ONLY change scheduled for tonight 23:00 UTC in 2h. Change-id: cfg-202604-17. Targets: routing weights + batching + timeouts. Canary: 5% traffic for 15m. Link: https://internal.redwood/cfg/cfg-202604-17 :rocket:

jana: quick summary?

deploy-bot: details attached in release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/cfg-202604-17 (short)
- routing: move 10% weight from default-route -> low-latency-route for small requests (<256 tokens)
- batching: max_batch_size: 64 -> 48; prefer_microbatch: true
- per-tenant concurrency cap: max_concurrency: 32 -> 24 (config-only)
- token_timeout_ms: 30000 -> 25000 (shorten tail)
- fallback-policy: if p95_latency >= 1.2x baseline OR error_rate > 0.5% -> auto-unwind to previous config

marc: Why reduce batch size? cost regressed last time when we tightened batch sizing.

priya: We observed a latency tail when large mixes hit KV cache misses. Smaller batch helps p99 for interactive routes. This is targeted at low-latency-route only, not all routes.

chris: Are we pinning model versions for canary? I don't want model drift to confuse the metric.

jana: Good call. For canary traffic we'll pin model foo-v2.3.1; full rollout may use foo-v2.3.2 but that stays unpinned until later.

op-sre: Monitoring checklist:
- dashboards: routing-latency, batch-size-distribution, tenant-error-rate, kvcache-hit-rate
- alerts: p95 latency +15% over baseline (5m), traffic-error-rate >0.5% (5m), infra-ooms
- smoke tests: end-to-end chat generation + embedding path (script: scripts/smoke/canary_smoke.sh)

marc: Add a specific check for tail-latency on requests with >512 seq. Last time that regressed.

priya: Added. Also enabling verbose traces for canary only (no logs retention change).

jana: Rollback plan spelled out: manual rollback command + automatic unwind. Manual: `redwoodctl config rollback cfg-202604-16` (previous). Auto: deploy-bot will unwind if thresholds breached in canary window.

devops-bot: NOTE: This change touches tenant-floor routing weights. Sessions pinned to older routing may see slight rebalancing. No DB schema changes.

chris: How long is the change window?

deploy-bot: Change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Canary 23:00-23:15, 25% ramp 23:15-23:35, 100% 23:35-23:50, cooldown until 01:00. Manual hold at any step.

marc: If we see CPU on dedicated hosts spike >20% should we cap concurrency further or pause rollout?

op-sre: Pause rollout. Ops oncall to pin to previous config and drain new routing. Escalation: @priyaa if we need hotfix.

priya: Also note tenant-exclusion list for canary: exclude paying-tier tenants (id list) so we avoid billing impacts.

jana: Release notes (short): "Reduce batch size and token timeout for low-latency route; adjust routing weights to favor low-latency route for small requests; tighten per-tenant concurrency cap. Canary pinned to foo-v2.3.1. Auto-unwind thresholds added."

chris: Who's on hand during rollout?

jana: Oncall: op-sre (primary), marc (eng lead), priya (prod owner). Me (jana) will coordinate. devops-bot will post progress updates.

devops-bot: Action: creating rollout job id roll-202604-58. Canary job created -> monitoring hooks wired.

marc: One more ask: leave a tiny grace for token_timeout for long-context eval path (we have a small cohort). Put an explicit tenant override rule in config for eval tenants.

priya: Done — eval-tenant IDs have token_timeout_ms: 30000 in the canary.

op-sre: Reminder: if we hit auto-unwind, collect heap + kernel traces (`/opt/ops/collect_trace.sh --id $rollid`) and tag the incident.

chris: LGTM from me.

jana: LGTM. Starting rollout in ~10m. Will post updates. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: roll-202604-58: canary started at 1741112223. 5% traffic -> low-latency-route pinned, foo-v2.3.1 pinned for canary.

(devops-bot): Progress: canary metrics look stable at 10m. p95 latency +2%, error_rate 0.12%

op-sre: keeping eyes open. No signs of KV pressure yet.

marc: Observed slight increase in tokenization time for long requests, but within thresholds.

deploy-bot: roll-202604-58: ramp to 25% at 23:16 UTC.

(devops-bot): 23:25 update: p95 +6%, error_rate 0.18%, cpu on some hosts +8%

priya: holding at 25% for additional 10m to see tail behavior.

jana: holding.

(devops-bot): 23:35 update: after extended hold, tail stabilized, moving to 100% traffic.
deploy-bot: roll-202604-58: full rollout 23:40 UTC -> config active globally.

op-sre: Post-roll checks running. Patch metrics collection saved under logs/cfg-202604-17/summary.json

chris: Can someone confirm rebalancing effects for tenant A+B? I saw a jump in request distribution.

priya: Tenant A was on routing-old; we sent a migration bump which caused a brief reassign. Nothing persistent.

jana: Closing notes: will open a short RCA if we see >0.5% error or >10% sustained p95 for 30m. Otherwise this is a config-only improvement to latency economics. Thanks team.

deploy-bot: roll-202604-58: status: SUCCESS (no auto-unwind). Completed 1741112560.

chris: great job, thanks everyone :tada:

jana: will follow up with a post-roll short doc in docs/changes/cfg-202604-17.md

op-sre: archived alerts and dashboards snapshot saved.

priya: leaving it in monitor mode for next 24h. Notify if anything looks off.
